what_differs: The client set the welcome-email fraud tool API integration (fraud results written back to Salesforce) as a fast follow on 2026-08-04. No Jira issue, epic, Holding Pen or Phase 2 item records it; WAGR-474 only asks whether moving a Sign-Up to In Progress sends a welcome email.
